user.title: Set up S2 PEBC
user.description:
Turns Home Assistant into an S2 CEM that Resource Managers (EV chargers, heat pumps, etc.) can connect to over WebSocket.

Your Home Assistant URL: `{baseUrl}`

1. Click **Submit** on this dialog box.
2. Start the pairing process from your Resource Manager.

After initiating pairing, open this integration's **Configure** (settings button) to get a one-time pairing token or check your Home Assistant notifications.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of S2 PEBC is allowed.
abort.not_loaded: The S2 PEBC integration is not running. Reload the integration and try again.

init.title: Pair a Resource Manager
init.description:
Enter the following in the pairing interface of your Resource Manager:

**HA URL:** `{baseUrl}`

**Token:** `{token}`

**Valid until:** {validUntil}

Click Submit once you have entered the credentials.
